digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with UN General Assembly debate Day 3. Asia-Pacific carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर एशिया-प्रशांत की अगुवाई है, भारतीय सैलानियों के भरोसे चलता था जो देश, अब पाकिस्तान से मिला रहा हाथ, हिंद महासागर में बढ़ी टेंशन मुख्य खबर है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: UN General Assembly debate Day 3
articles.summary: As the high-level debate enters a fourth day, The Takeaway looks back at key highlights on Thursday, with Israeli and Palestinian leaders presenting divergent views on the Middle East conflict and their counterparts from across the world weighing in on the far-reaching impacts of the ongoing crisis in Gaza and the occupied West Bank. articles.title: Rahman’s UN debut carries family weight, high national stakes
articles.summary: When Bangladeshi Prime Minister Tarique Rahman addressed the United Nations General Assembly for the first time on Thursday (September 24), he became the third member of his immediate family to speak from the UN podium. His father, President Ziaur Rahman, addressed the General Assembly in 1980, speaking on self-reliance and regional cooperation.

articles.title: ‘We’re going to win. We have no other choice’
articles.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told the UN General Assembly that Israel’s strikes on Iran are a matter of national survival. He dismissed West Bank violence as the work of a handful of juvenile delinquents and called accusations of genocide in Gaza the greatest lie of the century. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu used his address to the UN General Assembly to defend Israel’s strikes against Iran as a matter of national survival and describe the violence in the West Bank as the work of few “juvenile delinquents” and reject accusations of genocide in Gaza as “the greatest lie of the century.”.

articles.title: Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’

articles.title: World leaders approve new declaration to tackle rising sea levels
articles.summary: Sea level rise is among the most visible consequences of global warming, but for some countries, it is an imminent existential threat. World leaders tackle sea level rise, a stark marker of climate change.

articles.summary: Nepal PM Thanked India: नेपाल के प्रधानमंत्री बालेन शाह ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा के मंच से भारत को धन्यवाद दिया. उन्होंने भोटेकोशी-त्रिशूली आपदा के बाद भारत और चीन की मदद को याद किया. शाह ने कहा कि दोनों पड़ोसी देशों ने नेपाल को तुरंत और खुले दिल से मदद की. उन्होंने इस आपदा को पूरी दुनिया के लिए चेतावनी बताया. इसके साथ ही शाह ने हिमालय को लेकर बड़ा प्रस्ताव रखा.
